import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate revenue by month and region
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
summary = df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
pivot = summary.pivot(index='month', columns='region', values='revenue')

ax = pivot.plot(kind='bar', figsize=(8, 5))
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.set_title('Revenue by Month and Region')
ax.set_ylim(0, pivot.max().max() * 1.12)
ax.legend(title='Region')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
